minutes.headline: Library trustees approved amended December minutes unanimously and heard director's report; no budget votes taken.
minutes.summary: The Library Board met by Zoom, approved the December 17 minutes as amended, and heard the director's report on spending, the FY22 budget process, programs and the strategic plan. The director introduced the trustee handbook, the strategic plan subcommittee reported progress with its consultant, and the select board liaison gave a state-aid outlook. The meeting adjourned at 7:49.

public_comment.topic: A speaker relayed Facebook thanks to the library staff, and to Debbie, for children's programs.

votes.motion: Accept the minutes of December 17 as amended.

budget_items.what_was_said: Minutes were corrected to say earlier lower heating costs were due to a malfunctioning furnace. The director expects no heating savings in FY22.
The director reported spending roughly on schedule seven months into the fiscal year, with large electricity and heating months ahead.
The library received a target budget from the town manager and sent back requests. Meetings with the town manager and Finance Committee are scheduled.
The camera was bought from the library materials line, not by the Friends.
The director said the library is a small part of the town-wide budget.
The liaison said state revenue is about a sixth of the town budget and early indications are cautiously optimistic.

decisions.decision: Next meeting to start earlier, around 6:30, to wrap up by 7:30 so the director can attend the Finance Committee meeting.
Director will send the trustee handbook in sections each month for discussion.

what_happened.line: Library trustees approved the December 17 minutes as amended; no budget votes were taken at the meeting.
The director said spending was roughly on schedule, with large electricity and heating months still ahead and no heating savings expected in FY22.
The library has received a target budget from the town manager and sent back requests; meetings with the town manager and Finance Committee are scheduled.
The select board liaison said state revenue is about a sixth of the town budget and early indications are cautiously optimistic.
The director will send the trustee handbook in sections each month for discussion.

why_it_matters: The library's FY22 request is still being negotiated with the town manager and Finance Committee, and state aid affects how much the town budget, mostly taxes, has to cover.
Heating and electricity costs are expected to stay high next year, which bears on the library's operating request.
watch_next: The library's meetings with the town manager and the Finance Committee on the FY22 budget.
The next trustees meeting, planned to start around 6:30 so the director can attend the Finance Committee meeting.
